title: pvComputeMoleculeBonds
body:
## pvComputeMoleculeBonds

Adds single bonds to a molecule (vtkMolecule) from interatomic distances alone: two atoms are bonded when their distance is below the sum of their covalent radii widened by Tolerance. Valence, hybridization, aromaticity and bond order are ignored, so every bond is single. Use it when atoms come without connectivity, e.g. after pvConvertIntoMolecule or a coordinate-only reader, and follow with pvMoleculeToLines to turn the bonds into line cells.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- The covalent radii are VTK's periodic-table (Blue Obelisk) values in ångströms, so atom coordinates must be in ångströms; nanometre or bohr coordinates give missing or spurious bonds.
- Every bond is single and inferred from distance alone; do not use the result for bond-order or valence analysis.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ComputeMoleculeBonds`. Identity: `filters/ComputeMoleculeBonds`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: molecules (vtkMolecule). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkMolecule"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `IsToleranceAbsolute` | This property determines if the tolerance is absolute (value is added to radius and should be positive) or not (value multiplied with radius and should be greater than 1). | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Tolerance` | This property determines the tolerance to apply on covalent radius. | `{"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
